cmd:
for i in $(seq 1 30); do if ! pgrep -f sez_random.py >/dev/null && [ -s /tmp/sez2.log ]; then break; fi; sleep 5; done
grep -e "<--" /tmp/ext.log | awk '{print $2}' | tr '\n' ' '
echo
grep -c "^ok" /tmp/ext.log
tail -n 14 /tmp/sez2.log
pgrep -f sez_random.py >/dev/null && echo RUNNING || echo FINISHED
